scientific_program: separate fresh terrestrial population-heterozygosity project; no reopening any TTF-Q or relational v0.3 outcome
primary_test: One species-hash split; within-study group centered, equal study/group weighted linear OLS with baseline 0BP bioclim4 + latitude + longitude + log(N) + N-missing indicator; alternate adds exactly one 4-var 21ka-0BP magnitude; heldout group average pairwise He-difference MSE relative gain; species clustered bootstrap 1999 draws seed 20261029, positive only if 95% lower bound >0.
duplicate_rule: If repeated Pop_id and coordinate have identical numeric He values, retain once; if conflicting, exclude that population ID. Different population IDs at identical coordinates are averaged per unique sampled site.
